hero.title: We built the bridge we wished existed
hero.subtitle: SmartAutoBid exists because buying a U.S. vehicle from overseas shouldn't require a broker's license, a customs law degree, and a friend in Savannah.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: SmartAutoBid started with a simple frustration: incredible vehicles sell every day at Copart and IAAI auctions across the U.S., but buyers overseas are locked out — no dealer license, no local presence, no way to inspect a lot in person.

We built a team that lives inside that gap. Buyers who know how to read an auction report, a logistics desk that knows every export document by heart, and a support team that speaks the languages our clients do.
Today we source, buy, and ship vehicles from coast to coast in the U.S. to ports across Europe, the Caucasus, and the Middle East — handling the parts our clients never want to think about twice.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The questions we hear most before someone sends their first inquiry.

items.question: How does bidding work?
items.answer: Tell us the lot number, or the make, model, and budget you're after. We review the listing, agree a maximum bid with you in writing, and bid on your behalf directly at Copart or IAAI under our own account. We never bid past the limit you approve.

items.question: What happens if we don't win the bid?
items.answer: There's no cost to you — we only charge fees once a vehicle is actually purchased. You're welcome to set a new limit or try another lot.

items.question: What condition are the vehicles in?
items.answer: Most vehicles sourced through Copart and IAAI are salvage, insurance, or wholesale vehicles sold as-is. We review the auction's condition report and photos in good faith before bidding, but we don't inspect vehicles in person unless specifically arranged with you.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: We provide our brokerage fee plus an estimate of auction, transport, and shipping costs in writing before we place any bid, so you know the full picture upfront — no surprise line items.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Timelines vary by carrier schedule, port congestion, and customs processing, so we give you an estimate rather than a fixed date, and keep you updated at each shipping milestone.

items.question: Where do you ship to?
items.answer: We regularly ship to Klaipėda (Lithuania), Poti (Georgia), and Rotterdam (Netherlands), with additional ports across Europe, the Caucasus, and the Middle East available on request.

items.question: Who handles customs and import duties?
items.answer: We prepare the export documentation on the U.S. side. Import duties, VAT, and destination-country compliance are the client's responsibility, though we're happy to help coordinate with your local customs broker.

items.question: What languages do you support?
items.answer: Our team works with clients in English, Russian, and Lithuanian.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information when you use SmartAutoBid.

sections.title: Who we are
body: This Privacy Policy explains how Smart Auto Bid LLC ("SmartAutoBid," "we," "us"), a Georgia, USA limited liability company registered at 289 Telfair Rd #I, Savannah, GA 31415, USA, collects, uses, and protects information when you visit smartautobid.com or contact us through it.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: Contact and quote requests: when you submit our contact form, we collect your name, email address, phone number (if provided), the vehicle or budget details you describe, and any message you write.
Cost calculator: if you request a price estimate for a route we don't have instant pricing for, we collect the email address you provide so we can follow up with a quote.

Technical data: like most websites, our hosting infrastructure may automatically log standard technical information such as your IP address, browser type, and pages visited, for security and performance purposes.
Language preference: we store a small cookie recording which language (English, Russian, or Lithuanian) you've selected, so the site remembers it on your next visit.

sections.title: How we use your information
body: To respond to your inquiry and provide a quote for bidding, purchase, and shipping services.
To provide the services you request if you become a client, including bid management, documentation, and shipment coordination.
To communicate with you about your inquiry or order, in your selected language where possible.
To maintain and improve the security and functionality of our website.
We do not use your information for automated advertising profiling, and we do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: Cookies
body: SmartAutoBid uses strictly necessary, functional cookies that don't require consent — for example, a cookie that remembers your selected site language.

With your consent, we also use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our site so we can improve it. These analytics cookies are only set after you accept them in the cookie banner shown on your first visit — you're free to decline, and your choice doesn't affect your ability to use the site.
We do not use advertising or marketing cookies, and we do not sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: How we share your information
body: Email delivery: messages submitted through our contact form are delivered to our team via a standard email service provider, which processes the message only to deliver it to us.

Auction platforms: if you ask us to bid on a specific lot, we act on your behalf directly with Copart or IAAI using our own account — we do not share your personal contact details with them unless it's necessary to complete a purchase or shipment you've authorized.

Shipping and customs partners: once you're a client, we share the information necessary to arrange inland transport, export documentation, ocean freight, and customs clearance with vetted logistics and customs partners.
Legal requirements: we may disclose information if required to do so by law or in response to valid legal process.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Data retention
body: We keep inquiry and client information for as long as needed to respond to you, provide our services, meet our legal, tax, and accounting obligations, and resolve any disputes — after which we delete or anonymize it.

sections.title: Your rights
body: If you are located in the European Economic Area, you have the right under GDPR to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information, to object to certain processing, to receive a copy of your data in a portable format, and to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

Regardless of where you're located, you can contact us at any time using the details below to ask what information we hold about you or to request that we delete it, and we will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.title: International data transfers
body: SmartAutoBid is based in the United States, and information you submit is processed and stored there. By using our site or services, clients located outside the U.S. — including in the EU/EEA — acknowledge that their information will be transferred to and processed in the United States.

sections.title: Data security
body: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect the information you share with us. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Children's privacy
body: Our services are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

sections.title: Contact us
body: Questions about this policy or your information can be sent to info@smartautobid.com, by phone or WhatsApp at +1 (912) 561-2347, or by mail to Smart Auto Bid LLC, 289 Telfair Rd #I, Savannah, GA 31415, USA.

hero.title: Terms of Use and Service
hero.subtitle: These Terms of Use and Service govern the use of Smart Auto Bid LLC's services. Smart Auto Bid LLC acts as an independent intermediary and logistics coordinator between vehicle auction platforms and providers of transport, handling, and international shipping services, in order to facilitate the acquisition, transport, and export of vehicles.

intro: By registering, placing an order, making a payment, participating in an auction, or otherwise using Smart Auto Bid LLC's services, the client confirms that they have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms.

sections.title: 1. Smart Auto Bid LLC's role as an intermediary
body: Smart Auto Bid LLC acts solely as an independent intermediary and logistics coordinator between third-party vehicle auction platforms, including but not limited to Copart and IAAI, and providers of transport, handling, warehousing, and international shipping services.

Smart Auto Bid LLC is not an auction platform, a vehicle manufacturer, or a seller, and does not acquire title to the vehicles offered at auction, unless expressly stated otherwise in writing in a specific case.
Smart Auto Bid LLC may provide the following services:
granting eligible clients access to third-party auction platforms;
placing bids at auction on the client's instructions;
coordinating collection of the vehicle from the auction or seller location;
arranging delivery of the vehicle to a warehouse, terminal, or export port;
coordinating receipt, storage, processing, and loading of the vehicle;
receiving, holding, and forwarding vehicle documents where these are provided by the auction, the seller, or another third party;
coordinating container loading and ocean transport to the destination chosen by the client;
providing other administrative and logistics coordination services.

Auctions, sellers, inland carriers, warehouses, terminals, handling companies, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and shipping lines are independent third parties. They are not employees, agents, partners, or controlled companies of Smart Auto Bid LLC, unless expressly established otherwise in writing.

The purchase and sale of a vehicle is concluded under the rules of the specific auction or seller. Full responsibility for placing a bid, selecting the vehicle, purchasing it, and transferring title rests with the client, the auction, and the seller under their mutual agreements.

sections.title: 2. Client account and eligibility to use the services
body: The client must provide accurate, complete, and current registration, identity, company, payment, delivery, and export information.
Smart Auto Bid LLC has the right to request:
identity documents;
company registration documents;
ultimate beneficial owner details;
confirmation of the source of funds;
importer or consignee information;
any additional information needed to comply with legal, sanctions, anti-money-laundering, or export control requirements.
The client is responsible for all actions taken through their account. The client may not transfer the account to another person or allow it to be used by unauthorised persons.

Smart Auto Bid LLC may suspend or terminate the client's access to the services if the information provided is false, the client breaches these terms, fails to meet payment obligations, or where reasonable legal, sanctions, fraud, or security risks arise.

sections.title: 3. Auction bids and vehicle acquisition
body: A client's instruction to place a bid at auction is binding and, once the bid wins, generally cannot be withdrawn.
The client is solely responsible for:
inspecting the selected vehicle;
assessing the vehicle's history, photographs, and description;
assessing the type of title document;
calculating repair, transport, duty, tax, and import costs;
the vehicle's suitability for export and import;
complying with all auction fees and deadlines.

Auction results, vehicle availability, reserve price, seller approval, and other sale conditions depend on third parties. Smart Auto Bid LLC does not guarantee that a client's bid will be accepted or that the vehicle will be sold to the client.

sections.title: 4. Payments, fees, and arrears
body: The client must pay on time:
the purchase price of the vehicle;
auction and seller fees;
Smart Auto Bid LLC service or brokerage fees;
inland transport costs;
storage, loading, terminal, and port charges;
ocean freight costs;
customs, documentation, insurance, and other applicable charges.

All price calculations provided are preliminary unless expressly stated to be final. Prices may change due to fuel prices, shipping line tariffs, port charges, currency exchange rates, the size or condition of the vehicle, additional services, and other circumstances outside Smart Auto Bid LLC's control.
The client is responsible for bank transfer, currency exchange, credit card, chargeback, and other charges imposed by financial service providers.
If payment is not made on time, Smart Auto Bid LLC may:
suspend the provision of services;
withhold documents or the vehicle to the extent permitted by applicable law;
refuse to release the vehicle or arrange its onward transport;
refer the debt for collection;

Service, auction, transport, loading, and administration fees already paid are non-refundable where the service has already been ordered, has been started, or an obligation to a third party has arisen, except where mandatory applicable law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 5. Condition of vehicles
body: All vehicles acquired through auctions or other third-party sellers are sold under the rules of the relevant auction or seller, generally on an "as is, where is" basis, without express or implied warranties.
Smart Auto Bid LLC does not inspect and does not warrant a vehicle's:

mileage accuracy;
completeness;
quality of repair;
safety;
mechanical or electronic operation;
vehicle history;
eligibility for registration or road use;
compliance with destination country requirements;
accuracy of photographs or the auction description.
The client understands and agrees that a vehicle may:
be damaged, flood-affected, fire-damaged, dismantled, or non-running;
have hidden damage or damage not stated in the auction description;
be missing keys, parts, the battery, or other components;
have changed in condition between the time it was photographed and the time it is collected;
fail to meet safety, emissions, type-approval, registration, or import requirements in the destination country.
The client assumes all risk relating to the selection, repair, use, registration, transport, export, and import of the vehicle.

sections.title: 6. Title and other documents
body: Smart Auto Bid LLC does not guarantee the existence, type, validity, issuing timeframe, or suitability of title documents for export, registration, or import.
Documents are issued by the auction, the seller, an insurance company, a vehicle registration authority, or another third party. Document issuing timeframes are outside Smart Auto Bid LLC's control.
The client is solely responsible for assessing the document type, legal restrictions, and suitability, including:

sections.title: 7. Inland transport, storage, and loading
body: Inland carriers, warehouses, terminals, handling companies, and other service providers are independent third parties.
Stated collection, delivery, loading, or sailing timeframes are approximate and are not guaranteed.

The client understands that transporting or loading damaged, non-running, or non-standard vehicles may require towing, lifting, a forklift, a winch, additional labour, or other special equipment. Additional charges may apply for these services.
The client is responsible for all storage costs arising from:

sections.title: 8. Ocean transport
body: Smart Auto Bid LLC may coordinate ocean transport through independent shipping lines, freight forwarders, carriers, or other logistics service providers.
Ocean transport is additionally subject to the terms of the specific carrier, shipping line, freight forwarder, terminal, or bill of lading.
Vessel schedules, transit times, ports, routes, and container availability may change without prior notice.

The client must collect the cargo at the destination on time and pay all local costs, including duties, taxes, unloading, terminal, demurrage, detention, storage, and other charges.

sections.title: 9. Risk of damage, loss, and insurance

Smart Auto Bid LLC is not liable for damage, loss, theft, deterioration, or missing parts arising from the acts or omissions of independent carriers, terminals, warehouses, ports, shipping lines, or other third parties.
The client is advised to purchase transport and marine cargo insurance separately. Insurance is not automatically included in the price of the services unless expressly confirmed in writing.
Claims for damage occurring during transport must be submitted directly to the responsible carrier, shipping line, terminal, or insurance company in accordance with their procedures and deadlines.
Smart Auto Bid LLC may, so far as reasonably possible, assist the client in submitting documents for a claim, but does not guarantee that the claim will be satisfied.

sections.title: 10. Export and import requirements

The export of used self-propelled vehicles from the United States may be subject to US customs requirements, including 19 CFR § 192.2 and other applicable legislation.

sections.title: 17. Complaints and claims
body: The client must notify Smart Auto Bid LLC in writing of any problem or claim as soon as possible.
A claim must include:
the client's name or company name;
the vehicle identification number;
the order or invoice number;
a description of the problem;
photographs and other supporting documents;
the resolution sought.
Claims for visible damage to a vehicle must be recorded at the time of receipt and submitted within the deadline set by the carrier, terminal, insurer, or other responsible party.

sections.title: 18. Governing law and dispute resolution
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Georgia, United States of America, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.
Before commencing formal proceedings, the parties undertake to seek in good faith to resolve the dispute by negotiation.
If the dispute is not resolved within 30 calendar days of a written claim being submitted, it will be resolved in the competent courts of Chatham County, State of Georgia, United States of America.
Where mandatory consumer protection provisions apply to the client, this section does not limit rights that cannot be waived under the law.

sections.title: 19. Electronic communications
body: The client agrees to receive agreements, invoices, notices, confirmations, documents, and other information by email, through the website, through the client account, or by other electronic means.
Electronic consent, ticking a checkbox, placing an order, or making a payment has the same legal effect as a physical signature, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

sections.title: 20. Changes to the terms
body: Smart Auto Bid LLC may amend these terms from time to time.

The updated version takes effect once published on the website or on any other date stated there. Continued use of the services after the changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
Material changes do not apply retroactively to an order already confirmed, unless required by law or agreed otherwise in writing by the parties.

sections.title: 21. Severability
body: If any provision of these terms is held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in full force and effect.
An invalid provision must be replaced with a valid provision that most closely reflects the original economic and legal purpose.

sections.title: 22. Entire agreement
body: These terms, together with the specific order, invoice, quote, auction rules, and other terms confirmed in writing, constitute the entire agreement between the client and Smart Auto Bid LLC regarding the services provided.
Oral statements or agreements are not valid unless confirmed in writing by an authorised representative of Smart Auto Bid LLC.

bronze.name: Bronze
bronze.tagline: No deposit. We find the car and place the bids together with you — you pay only when you buy.
bronze.terms: The Bronze plan requires no deposit. We search the auctions together with you: we help you find the vehicle you are looking for, calculate the full landed cost including fees, shipping and customs, and give you our honest view of the car's condition and resale prospects before you commit. Every bid is placed by us on your behalf. Our service fee is {fee} per vehicle, payable only when you successfully buy — if you never buy, you owe us nothing.

silver.name: Silver
silver.tagline: Bid on your own, one lot at a time.
silver.terms: The Silver plan requires a {deposit} deposit, which is fully refundable once you finish working with us, provided no bids are active. It allows bids up to $10,000 with one active bid at a time, and a service fee of {fee} per vehicle purchased. This plan opens once our own auction access is live.

gold.name: Gold
gold.tagline: More bidding power, two lots in play at once.
gold.terms: The Gold plan requires a {deposit} deposit, which is fully refundable once you finish working with us, provided no bids are active. It allows bids up to $25,000 with two active bids at a time, and a service fee of {fee} per vehicle purchased. This plan opens once our own auction access is live.

platinum.name: Platinum
platinum.tagline: Our highest limits, built for regular buyers.
platinum.terms: The Platinum plan requires a {deposit} deposit, which is fully refundable once you finish working with us, provided no bids are active. It allows bids up to $50,000 with five active bids at a time, and a service fee of {fee} per vehicle purchased. Self-bidding can be arranged on this plan after speaking with us. This plan opens once our own auction access is live.
